biggest_catch: Invitation-only with a waitlist (space is limited) — you cannot just sign up and start earning; and the receipt reward is capped at $10/month paid as Amazon Balance (store credit), not cash.
catches: Invitation-only program; download the app to join a waitlist and wait for an email invitation — no guaranteed timeline.
Receipt rewards capped at up to $10/month; per-receipt values vary by retailer type (some receipt types pay $0.15–$0.25 each).
Reward is Amazon Balance (spendable at Amazon.com) or charitable donation — not cash.
Receipts must be shared by 11:59 PM PST on the last day of the month; extra receipts don't carry over.
Only one reward type per month; receipts from Amazon-owned businesses and certain categories (medical, gambling, firearms, housing, transit, tuition, childcare, legal/financial) are ineligible.
Amazon uses the receipt data to improve product selection and ad relevance — the data-for-reward trade-off is inherent.
Surveys and ad-verification rewards vary; disabling ad verification >48 cumulative hours in a month forfeits that month's reward.

eligibility: Amazon customers 18+ in the US (also UK, Canada, Germany, France, Spain, Japan); invitation-only with waitlist; only eligible for parts of the program shown in-app.
notes: Strong official evidence on panel.amazon.com Rewards FAQ: exact $10/month receipt cap, Amazon Balance payout, monthly issuance within first 48 hours of the following month. Framed as a data-for-reward panel, not passive income — you share receipts Amazon would otherwise not see.
numeric_basis: payout from official FAQ (up to $10/month for receipts; surveys variable); time: 5-15 min active per receipt batch per Lane A standard

payout_value_note: Monthly receipt reward capped at $10, paid as Amazon Balance (Amazon store credit), not cash.

steps: Download the Amazon Shopper Panel app and join the waitlist (invitation-only; space is limited).
When invited, accept the invitation and sign in with your Amazon account.
Each month, upload eligible receipts from non-Amazon purchases: snap paper receipts in the app or forward e-receipts to receipts@panel.amazon.com.
Optionally complete short surveys and enable ad verification for additional rewards.
Choose your monthly reward type: Amazon Balance (default) or charitable donation.
Receive the reward within the first 48 hours of the following month, with an email confirmation.
timing: Rewards issued once per month, within the first 48 hours of the following month; receipts must be shared by 11:59 PM PST on the last day of the month.
